also.hook: Patel has run product at four different points along enterprise software's evolution, content management at Doculabs, cloud file sync at EMC and Syncplicity, cloud content at Box, and now security, collaboration, and AI infrastructure at Cisco, rising to President and Chief Product Officer as the company repositions its networking core around AI.
also.name: Jeetu Patel
also.moniker: President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco

name: Security Leaders
blurb: CISOs and security executives defending organisations that now run AI, and against it.

profiles.hook: Moisant built his career on the operational spine of technology organizations, infrastructure, security, enterprise platforms, and the internal systems that keep large companies running. At Indeed, overseeing 300 million monthly visitors and three million employers, he sits at the intersection of consumer scale and enterprise risk, leading both the CIO and CSO functions simultaneously.
profiles.name: Anthony Moisant
